messages:
maria: Follow-up from today's outage — capturing owners for postmortem actions and timeline so we can de-risk recurring vendor control-plane spikes.
ops-bot: Incident ID 2026-0508 created. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-0508 :spiral_note_pad:
sam: Short root cause: vendor control-plane rate spike -> token refresh 5xx -> registry retrier immediately retried -> TTL fallback mis-configured -> retry amplification.
zara: immediate items I propose: client-side backoff + global circuit-breaker, registry safe-TTL + auto-throttle, and a regional canary for token refresh. Owners below.
kevin: I'll own vendor comms and SLA escalation. ETA for vendor request: 10 days.
zara: ACTION-10: client backoff + jitter + metrics (owner:zara, eta:2026-05-11, est:8h)
sam: ACTION-11: registry TTL floor + auto-heal + feature flag (owner:sam, eta:2026-05-18, est:12h)
zara: ACTION-12: multi-region token-refresh canary PoC (owner:zara, poc:2026-05-07, rollout:2026-05-21, est:6h)
kevin: ACTION-13: vendor postmortem ask + durable on-call contact (owner:kevin, eta:2026-05-17)
maria: ops trend: we see 4 small auth blips over last 5 months correlated with vendor maintenance windows. Recommend monthly "auth-path" resilience drill, owner: ops-sre rotation, first drill: 2026-05-25.
sam: add CI test that injects 5xx/429 into auth path to ensure graceful fallback. owner: sam, eta:2026-05-09, est:4h.
zara: example canary curl PoC: ```curl -X POST https://registry.internal/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{}'``` runs every 5m from each region.
kevin: vendor comms note: ask them to explain control-plane throttling behavior and request a soft quota increase or internal mitigation.
maria: I'll run weekly 15m triage (Mon 09:15 PT) until major actions closed. Tracker link: https://redwood.internal/trackers/pm-2026-0508 (internal). Please add hours/confirm ETAs.
ops-bot: Reminder created: weekly-postmortem-triage Mon 09:15 PT invited: maria, sam, zara, kevin.
sam: ACTION-11 hours: 12h. ACTION-CI test: 4h.
zara: ACTION-10:8h, ACTION-12 PoC:6h.
kevin: noted. I'll upload vendor ticket and set sensitive flag in tracker.
maria: please react with :eyes: when done so I can close out this thread and mark tracker canonical.
sam: :eyes:
kevin: :eyes:
